notes.title: A Tale Before the Farm Begins in Town Keeper!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/84145fb9e68e4fda503ad2105156719911f4c3eb.png

Ever wonder how your landlord got all that land in the first place?  Prepare to hop back in time with the prequel to Farm Keeper: Town Keeper! ️

The fluffy rabbit empire is on the rise, and your ancestors' village needs your help! Rebuild your home, train a wondrous army of fluffy defenders, and prevent the rabbit invasion! ⚔️

Town Keeper keeps the fun of tile-based management you loved in Farm Keeper, but this time, you'll have a helping hand from your adorable villagers. ‍‍‍ Focus on strategic decisions while your villagers scurry about building your town. ‍♀️

Discover exciting new features in Town Keeper!

 Tile-based town building focused on maximizing resource yields
 Train an army of fluffy defenders to protect your town
 Manage town resources, upgrades, trade, and research
 Flexible difficulty options from cozy to intense gameplay
 6 unique towns to unlock and play. New townhalls, perks, and rabbit characters to discover.
 Cute bunny!!! Oh yea!!!

Hop on over to the Town Keeper store page for more details!
Town Keeper

We can't wait to see you build your town and rewrite history in Town Keeper!

Happy Building!

notes.title: Mid-game save now available!
notes.content:
Hello farmers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/814601c994f4e89f677f6afd025095d33db9abf9.png

We're excited to introduce the highly requested mid-game save feature! While it may seem like a small addition, it required a massive effort from our two-person team to rewrite the game's core and thoroughly test it.

In the original design, Farm Keeper was meant for shorter sessions, which caused us to overlook the need for mid-game saves. We apologize for any inconvenience this caused and appreciate your patience and understanding.

How to Use Mid-Game Save:
Simply pause your game during a session and hit "Exit", the game will automatically save. When you return to Farm Keeper, hit "Continue" to pick up where you left off.

Why No Manual Save and Save Slots:
In response to your valuable feedback, we designed the new save feature to provide seamless continuity from where you left off in longer gaming sessions. Implementing a save slot system would have added unnecessary complexity and hindered the convenience of this feature. Furthermore, during our development, we discovered that manual saving could potentially lead to undesired play styles and exploits that jeopardized the integrity of Farm Keeper. This led us to opt for the mid-game save as a more balanced solution.

Limitations:
For larger farms, mid-game saves may take longer to process, and there's a slight risk of corruption for farms with 10,000+ tiles. To safeguard your progress, mid-game saves are kept separate from the main save file. Please note that mid-game saves do not support Steam Cloud.

Bug Reporting:
While we've conducted thorough testing, there may still be some hidden bugs lurking in the game. If you encounter any issues, whether related to the mid-game save or not, please reach out to us through the Steam community. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us continually improve Farm Keeper.

We sincerely appreciate your support and understanding. Thank you! 😊


- Napas -

notes.title: New tiles arrived!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/0fbf9b7ea092b570fb0e66f631f2a6b07c2ed5f6.png

Hello Farmers!
We're excited to bring you a fresh update packed with new features that will take your farming experience to the next level. Explore brand-new tiles with innovative mechanics that will supercharge your farm and offer you exciting new ways to play. Alongside these additions, we're introducing fresh challenges and an all-new cosmetic system that will let you customize ocean color like never before.

Introducing New Global Bonus Tiles
These game-changers will enhance other tiles across your farm. You're no longer confined to placing them adjacent to other tiles to enjoy their benefits. This newfound freedom will breathe new life into your lower-tier tiles, making them more relevant than ever as the game progresses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/7fbdc134094012cdbd966641859d3e30abd63c5d.png
🥔Potato Chips Factory: Ever wondered what to do with surplus potatoes? Say hello to the Potato Chips Factory, your solution to turning excess potatoes into gold! For every 10 potatoes harvested, this tile will churn out delicious potato chips. What was once merely animal feed will now become a profitable venture, especially during mini-collecting quests. The more chips the factory produces, the higher their value climbs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/e2427b23fe94666ba6eee10eeb37ddfa26d4bebe.png
🗼Lighthouse: A beacon of maritime marvel, the Lighthouse adds a strategic twist to your fishing routine. Once a day, it beckons all fishing boats to haul in squid or the elusive giant octopus. The odds of reeling in the legendary giant octopus receive a boost from your luck stat. Gone are the days of routine fishing – with the Lighthouse, your fishing fleet becomes a force to be reckoned with. Optimize their potential and discover their hidden depths.
Unlike the Weather Station or Tractor, global bonus tile grows stronger with each additional tile you lay down.


New Coconut Palm with Unique Stacking Mechanics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/0fe815b5ea5c99c136ad9f62afdb3726341cf2bc.png
In a departure from conventional wisdom, the Coconut Palm offers a different path to farm optimization. It generates stackable coconuts at an exponential rate, all without the need for watering. Watch in awe as these coconuts double in value every passing day when left on the Coconut Palm. Embrace this unique strategy by constructing Coconut Palms using just 1 wood (equivalent to 1 mushroom log).

Introducing Landlord’s Cactus and a Fresh Ocean Cosmetic System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/387c90c5d77384716aaff55a0dcedfcd48730755.png
The benevolent landlord, appreciating your dedication despite his exorbitant rent, bestows upon you a special gift – the Landlord’s Cactus. Unlock the Weather Station, and this cactus will make surprise appearances early in the game. Delicate and sensitive, it must be shielded from the perils of cutting, watering, and animal nibbling. Should you safeguard it till the end, a splendid ocean-colored cosmetic reward awaits – a tribute to the resilient cactus's hue. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/001cef7a18a21ccc2d6c304ac06c7b98fb72c3b2.png

It's worth noting that the cactus challenge is entirely optional; if you choose, you can chop it, gaining 1 wood instead. Keep in mind that certain cactus colors exclusively emerge at higher difficulty levels, adding an extra layer of challenge.

🎰 Slot Machine Thrills 🎰
Bad news! The landlord has spotted that you are getting rich from his casino. He has tweaked the Slot Machine – removing the guaranteed minimum reward! Your luck stat now only enhances your maximum prize. Brace yourself; it's all about your true luck now!

We hope you relish every moment of this update. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so don't hesitate to join the community and share your thoughts.

Thank you for being a part of our farming journey! :D

notes.title: Quality of Life update
notes.content:
Greetings, farmers! 

This update is all about improving your gameplay experience, based on your valuable feedback. Thank you for your input!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/b72cdaf0f373d83262d44f96ec250183c4b7bc89.gif

New Features:
- Progression Counter: Track secret tiles progression by holding [Tab] while playing.
- Auto Rain: Automatic use of the Weather Station when the day ends. Toggle this option using the Auto Rain button next to the stamina bar.
- Consecutive Build Mode: Easily build more of the selected tile by using [Shift + Click] while placing tiles.
- Keyboard Shortcuts: Discover a variety of new shortcuts in the pause menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/06a1f3401a0b3c3c393522cb0d9d5affd07e4e7d.png

New Settings:
- Automated Production: Enable or disable 1 click produce all for production buildings.
- Drag Action: Enable or disable tile drag to pow, plant, water, harvest, and collect.
- House Shortcut: Enable or disable using the house tile as a shortcut to finish the day.
- Warnings: You can now disable stamina and Weather Station warnings in settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/d4a93936b782bd3eed181d3c98431c6c5da541ec.png

Balance adjustment: 
- Slot Machine price is now 50 coins, 1 wood and 1 stone.
- Add diminishing return to Slot Machine reward bonus from luck.
- Add diminishing return to Diver's wood/stone treasure chance.
- Cider sell price increase to 30. Additionally, if you have an adjacent Retail Store tile, the sell price can be doubled.
- TRUE EPIC achievement condition has been changed to: Beat the Epic difficulty WITHOUT Corn and Slot Machine. (You still have TRUE EPIC if you previously earned it.)

We genuinely appreciate your feedback and constantly strive to enhance the game. Some significant changes, like adding a mid-game save feature, require time and effort to implement. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and sincerely appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for being part of this amazing community, and happy [strike]gambling[/strike] farming!

notes.title: New major update "Luck Be A Farmer"
notes.content:
Hello fellow farmers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/1659822fdf73dbbea8f24cb66c7690d24191e047.gif

We're thrilled to unveil "Luck Be A Farmer" the latest Farm Keeper update and a tribute to our inspiration "Luck be a landlord." The update filled with new luck-based tiles that add a whole new dimension to Farm Keeper for you to explore.

🎰 Slot Machine: Take a gamble and spin the reels by paying 5 coins. The rewards are entirely up to your luck, with a chance for massive payouts or a drain on your coins. High risk, high reward!

🤿 Diver: Dive deep into the sea and discover hidden treasures. The diver brings back random items, ranging from cheap boots to valuable pearls. Keep an eye out for the mini chest that can contain stone or wood. Luck plays a key role in what you find!

🦆 Goose: Summons the elusive goose with duck food. These special birds have a rare chance of laying a golden egg, which can fetch a hefty price. Your luck will determine the outcome!


Sometime RNG God just not on your side, we've introduced optional new tiles for boosting your luck to make it more manageable:

🍀 Clover: A luck-based plant that grants a bonus when fully grown. Keep it unharvested to maintain the luck boost. The selling price of Clover is also influenced by your luck!

⛩️ Shrine: Pay your respects to the rabbit god at the shrine and convert your remaining stamina into a temporary luck bonus. This bonus lasts for a day and can be stacked with other shrines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200216/525a1ebfcfc26500e4003ce607327283d424491b.png

Other changes in this update include:

✨ Auto Drink Option: Automatically use a random well when your stamina is depleted. Toggle the feature on or off from the button next to the stamina bar.

🐠 Big Fish and Ore Rock: These tiles are now affected by the new luck bonus.

🐣 Incubator Enhancements: The incubator can now hatch various types of eggs, including chickens, ducks, and geese.

🎃 Pumpkin Rework: Pumpkins now have the ability to expand to every adjacent blank tile on the same day they fully grow. Bug with Farmer also fixed.

💰 Increased Cow Sell Price: It's more like a Wagyu now.

🥚 Egg Balance Adjustment: Fine-tuned the balance of all eggs in the game for a more optimal gameplay experience.

🏨 Hotel Challenge Adjustment: Collect fewer sunflowers to complete it.

🐄 Fixed Empty Tile Purchase Bug: Canceling the purchase of an empty tile will no longer deduct your coins. Your funds are safe!

🔨 Build Button Enhancement: We've changed the masking color of the build button when you don't have enough resources, making it easier to navigate and plan your farm.

We also renamed the highest difficulty level from "Asian Difficulty" to "Epic Difficulty" (also the Steam Achievement). We apologize for any offense caused by the previous name and deeply regret any misunderstanding or hurt feelings it may have caused. Our intention was never to promote racism or discrimination, and we appreciate the feedback from everyone.

🏆New Steam Achievement: "TRUE EPIC" is now available for those who can conquer Epic mode WITHOUT using corn.

We hope you enjoy this exciting update and all the new luck-based features. As always, we value your feedback, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts in our community. Happy farming, and may the luck be ever in your favor!

- Napas -

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2: A cow went to the gym.
notes.content:
Howdy Farmer!

We're back with another update based on your fantastic feedback! This time around, we've focused on making the game more enjoyable for different playstyles and giving some extra love to our beloved livestock.


 Animal growth has been revamped! Now, your animals will gobble up those tasty farm plants right from the start of the day. No more waiting for another day to feed them.
 We've balanced the chicken eggs, ducks, duck eggs, and milk to align with this new feeding behavior.
 Brace yourself for some massive bonuses on the mountain tile. You'll be reaching new heights of success in no time!
 The water tile adjacent effect will now activate the moment it's placed in the game. Timing is everything, so make a splash and preserve that precious stamina (and tomatoes)!
 Our relax mode just got even more relaxing. Take a deep breath and soak in the tranquility.
 Oh, and we couldn't resist fixing a few pesky typos on some descriptions. Quality control, you know?


Thank you for being an amazing part of our farming community and providing us with your valuable feedback. Keep on growing, Farmer!

Mid-game save? We hear you! But it's a tough nut to crack without breaking things. We're working on it. Keep farming and stay tuned for updates. Thanks for being patient and understanding! 


Your whimsically quirky landlord
- Napas -

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Greetings, esteemed farmer!

Presenting Patch 1.0.1, a delightful update tailored to enhance your gaming experience thanks to invaluable community feedback.

Here's the scoop:


 Relax Mode has been given a makeover, so now it's more chill and less like a caffeinated squirrel on a sugar rush.
 We've thrown in a mini tutorial to ensure you master the fine art of feeding animals. No more guessing games!
 You'll now find a handy-dandy UI feature that effortlessly points out adjacent tiles.
 Squashed a pesky bug on Cider Press building.
 Corrected a few sneaky typos.


We sincerely hope you relish these improvements, and we encourage you to share your valuable feedback in our community hub discussion. Your insights are akin to rain nourishing our virtual crops!

Happy farming, and may your fields forever flourish!


- Napas -
